mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, COUNT(cs.id) AS enrollment_count FROM class_student cs JOIN edu_class ec ON ec.id = cs.class_id JOIN course c ON c.id = ec.course_id WHERE cs.status = 'ENROLLED' AND ec.status IN ('ENROLLING', 'IN_PROGRESS') GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY enrollment_count DESC, c.id LIMIT 5

SELECT ec.id AS class_id, ec.name AS class_name, ec.status, ec.enrolled_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status IN ('SCHEDULED', 'COMPLETED')) AS planned_lessons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_lessons, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED') = 0 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_student cs WHERE cs.class_id = ec.id AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED') = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s JOIN attendance a ON a.schedule_id = s.id AND a.status IN ('PRESENT', 'LATE') JOIN class_student cs ON cs.class_id = s.class_id AND cs.student_id = a.student_id AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED' WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED') / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED') * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_student cs WHERE cs.class_id = ec.id AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED')), 2) END AS attendance_rate FROM edu_class ec ORDER BY ec.start_date DESC, ec.id DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ec.id AS class_id, ec.name AS class_name, c.name AS course_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status IN ('SCHEDULED', 'COMPLETED')) AS planned_lessons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_lessons, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED') = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance a JOIN class_schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' AND a.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.status IN ('PRESENT', 'LATE')) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s WHERE s.class_id = ec.id AND s.status = 'COMPLETED'), 2) END AS attendance_rate FROM class_student cs JOIN edu_class ec ON ec.id = cs.class_id JOIN course c ON c.id = ec.course_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED' ORDER BY cs.enrolled_at DESC, cs.class_id DESC
